d.request: For equipment with above-average relative humidity, return all rows ranking in the top 10 positions when sorted by deviation from the above-average group mean (including all ties with the 10th position), showing equipment reference, average humidity, difference from all-equipment mean, and difference from group mean, sorted descending by group-mean deviation with missing values last.
d.sql:
WITH humidity_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(humepct) as overall_avg
  FROM scanenvironment
  WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL
),
equipment_humidity AS (
  SELECT 
    equipref,
    AVG(humepct) as avg_humidity
  FROM scanenvironment
  WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY equipref
),
above_avg_equipment AS (
  SELECT 
    eh.equipref,
    eh.avg_humidity,
    hs.overall_avg
  FROM equipment_humidity eh
  CROSS JOIN humidity_stats hs
  WHERE eh.avg_humidity > hs.overall_avg
),
group_mean_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) as group_mean
  FROM above_avg_equipment
),
with_deviations AS (
  SELECT 
    aae.equipref,
    aae.avg_humidity,
    aae.avg_humidity - aae.overall_avg as diff_from_all_mean,
    aae.avg_humidity - gmc.group_mean as diff_from_group_mean
  FROM above_avg_equipment aae
  CROSS JOIN group_mean_calc gmc
),
sorted_data AS (
  SELECT 
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY diff_from_group_mean DESC NULLS LAST
    ) as rn
  FROM with_deviations
),
cutoff AS (
  SELECT diff_from_group_mean
  FROM sorted_data
  WHERE rn = 10
)
SELECT 
  equipref,
  avg_humidity,
  diff_from_all_mean,
  diff_from_group_mean
FROM sorted_data
WHERE rn < 10
   OR (diff_from_group_mean IS NOT NULL AND diff_from_group_mean = (SELECT diff_from_group_mean FROM cutoff WHERE diff_from_group_mean IS NOT NULL))
   OR (diff_from_group_mean IS NULL AND (SELECT diff_from_group_mean FROM cutoff) IS NULL)
ORDER BY diff_from_group_mean DESC NULLS LAST

c.request: Among equipment whose average relative humidity (`scanenvironment.humepct`, ignoring missing readings) is above the average across all equipment, which are the top 10 by how far they sit above the mean of that above-average group? Show the equipment reference, its average humidity, how much it exceeds the all-equipment average, and its difference from the group mean. Return nothing if either reference average is missing, and sort from highest to lowest with missing values last. List the same ranking, but keep all equipment that ties with the 10th row, so more than 10 rows may come back.
c.sql:
WITH equipment_avg_humidity AS (
  SELECT 
    equipref,
    AVG(humepct) as avg_humidity
  FROM scanenvironment
  WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY equipref
),
all_equipment_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) as global_avg
  FROM equipment_avg_humidity
),
above_average_equipment AS (
  SELECT 
    eah.equipref,
    eah.avg_humidity,
    aea.global_avg
  FROM equipment_avg_humidity eah
  CROSS JOIN all_equipment_avg aea
  WHERE eah.avg_humidity > aea.global_avg
),
above_avg_group_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(avg_humidity) as group_mean
  FROM above_average_equipment
),
with_differences AS (
  SELECT 
    aae.equipref,
    aae.avg_humidity,
    (aae.avg_humidity - aae.global_avg) as exceeds_global,
    (aae.avg_humidity - aags.group_mean) as exceeds_group_mean,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (aae.avg_humidity - aags.group_mean) DESC NULLS LAST) as rn,
    NTH_VALUE((aae.avg_humidity - aags.group_mean), 10) OVER (
      ORDER BY (aae.avg_humidity - aags.group_mean) DESC NULLS LAST
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
    ) as nth_10_value
  FROM above_average_equipment aae
  CROSS JOIN above_avg_group_stats aags
  WHERE aae.avg_humidity IS NOT NULL
    AND aae.global_avg IS NOT NULL
    AND aags.group_mean IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  equipref,
  avg_humidity,
  exceeds_global,
  exceeds_group_mean
FROM with_differences
WHERE rn <= 10 OR exceeds_group_mean = nth_10_value
ORDER BY exceeds_group_mean DESC, equipref

a.request: For each piece of equipment (`scanenvironment.equipref`), average its relative humidity (`humepct`), ignoring missing readings. Keep only equipment whose average is above the average of all equipment averages. For these, show the equipment reference, its average humidity, how much that exceeds the all-equipment average, and how far it is from the mean humidity of just the kept equipment. Return nothing if either reference average is missing. Sort by that last difference from highest to lowest with missing values last, and return the top 10, plus any further rows that tie with the 10th.
a.sql: WITH equipment_averages AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) as eq_avg_humidity FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref), all_equipment_average AS (SELECT AVG(eq_avg_humidity) as global_avg_humidity FROM equipment_averages), filtered_equipment AS (SELECT ea.equipref, ea.eq_avg_humidity, aea.global_avg_humidity FROM equipment_averages ea CROSS JOIN all_equipment_average aea WHERE ea.eq_avg_humidity IS NOT NULL AND aea.global_avg_humidity IS NOT NULL AND ea.eq_avg_humidity > aea.global_avg_humidity), kept_equipment_mean AS (SELECT AVG(eq_avg_humidity) as kept_mean_humidity FROM filtered_equipment), final_results AS (SELECT fe.equipref, fe.eq_avg_humidity as avg_humidity, fe.eq_avg_humidity - fe.global_avg_humidity as exceeds_all_avg, fe.eq_avg_humidity - kem.kept_mean_humidity as diff_from_kept_mean FROM filtered_equipment fe CROSS JOIN kept_equipment_mean kem), sorted_results AS (SELECT equipref, avg_humidity, exceeds_all_avg, diff_from_kept_mean, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN diff_from_kept_mean IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, diff_from_kept_mean DESC) as rn FROM final_results) SELECT equipref, avg_humidity, exceeds_all_avg, diff_from_kept_mean FROM sorted_results WHERE rn <= 10 OR diff_from_kept_mean = (SELECT diff_from_kept_mean FROM sorted_results WHERE rn = 10) ORDER BY CASE WHEN diff_from_kept_mean IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, diff_from_kept_mean DESC

b.request: List equipment with above-average mean humidity ranked by their deviation from the above-average group mean, returning the top 10 plus all equipment tied at rank 10, showing equipment reference, mean humidity, excess above overall mean, and difference from group mean, sorted descending with nulls last.
b.sql: WITH humidity_stats AS (SELECT AVG(humepct) as overall_mean_humidity FROM scanenvironment WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL), equipment_humidity AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) as mean_humidity FROM scanenvironment WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY equipref), above_average AS (SELECT eh.equipref, eh.mean_humidity, eh.mean_humidity - hs.overall_mean_humidity as excess_above_overall FROM equipment_humidity eh CROSS JOIN humidity_stats hs WHERE eh.mean_humidity > hs.overall_mean_humidity), group_mean_calc AS (SELECT AVG(mean_humidity) as group_mean_humidity FROM above_average), ranked AS (SELECT aa.equipref, aa.mean_humidity, aa.excess_above_overall, aa.mean_humidity - gm.group_mean_humidity as diff_from_group_mean, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (aa.mean_humidity - gm.group_mean_humidity) DESC) as rnk FROM above_average aa CROSS JOIN group_mean_calc gm) SELECT equipref, mean_humidity, excess_above_overall, diff_from_group_mean FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= (SELECT MAX(rnk) FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 10) ORDER BY diff_from_group_mean DESC NULLS LAST
b.raw: List equipment with above-average mean humidity ranked by their deviation from the above-average group mean, returning the top 10 plus all equipment tied at rank 10, showing equipment reference, mean humidity, excess above overall mean, and difference from group mean, sorted descending with nulls last.
